items.source: As of Spring 4.2, the vast majority of the BeanWrapper features have been merged to AbstractPropertyAccessor, which means that property traversal as well as collections and map access is now supported here as well.
items.translation: 自 Spring 4.2 起，BeanWrapper 的绝大多数功能已合并到 AbstractPropertyAccessor，这意味着属性遍历以及集合和 Map 访问现在也在此处得到支持。

items.source:
A DirectFieldAccessor's default for the "extractOldValueForEditor" setting
is "true", since a field can always be read without side effects.
items.translation: DirectFieldAccessor 的 "extractOldValueForEditor" 设置的默认值为 "true"，因为字段总是可以无副作用地读取。
